31504-(R1864).s: The bill amends the Dutch Military Disciplinary Code to raise the maximum fine amounts (to €350 and €700 for missions abroad) and to cap monthly fines at €700 or €1,400. It also removes the restriction on imposing a going-out ban (uitgaansverbod) and adjusts cross-references in the code to reflect these changes.
31504-(R1864).j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the higher fine maxima by saying commanders consider the existing maxima too low given the current pay of professional soldiers.
q: In particular, commanders consider the current fine maxima far too low.
In het bijzonder worden de huidige boetemaxima door de commandanten als veel te laag ervaren.
p: Removing the former third paragraph of article 48 widens the range of going-out bans commanders may impose on servicemembers, with no added safeguards.

parties: Asks whether the disciplinary instrument remains adequate and usable, whether a broader evaluation of the Military Disciplinary Act will be done, and whether the commander's discretion over unwanted conduct under the curfew provision is unlimited.

The CDA members state that this bill largely meets the widely shared view that the disciplinary instruments available to commanders to maintain order and discipline in their unit were no longer sufficient on a number of points.

De leden van de fractie van het CDA geven aan dat dit wetsvoorstel in belangrijke mate tegemoet komt aan het breed gedeelde gevoelen dat het Tuchtrechtinstrumentarium dat commandanten ten dienste staat om de orde en tucht in hun eenheid in voorkomend geval te handhaven op een aantal punten niet meer toereikend was.
Welcomes the bill's preventive effect and asks whether spiritual care could play a stronger role in preventing unwanted conduct.
The SGP members have taken note with interest and approval of this bill, which aims to combat unwanted conduct within the armed forces.
De leden van de fractie van de SGP hebben met belangstelling en instemming kennisgenomen van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel, dat ten doel heeft het tegengaan van ongewenst gedrag binnen de krijgsmacht.

32365-(R1912).s: This bill asks the Staten-Generaal to approve the revised 2008 Strasbourg European Convention on the adoption of children for the whole Kingdom, as required by Article 91 of the Constitution. It also approves a reservation declining to accept Article 7(1)(a)(ii) of the Convention for the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba.
q: The revised European Convention on the adoption of children, concluded at Strasbourg on 27 November 2008, requires approval by the Staten-Generaal under Article 91(1) of the Constitution before the Kingdom can be bound by it.

Het op 27 november 2008 te Straatsburg totstandgekomen Europees Verdrag inzake de adoptie van kinderen (herzien) ingevolge artikel 91, eerste lid, van de Grondwet de goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal behoeft

parties: Asks about why the Netherlands did not join the 1967 convention, which states and reservations apply, and why the file retention period was extended to 50 years.
The VVD members have taken note of the bill with interest.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.
Welcomes the convention as a step for homo-emancipation and asks about participation of Aruba, Curaçao, Sint Maarten and the BES islands and the partnership reservation.
The PvdA members are pleased that Europe has made adoption by same-sex couples possible under treaty law.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn verheugd over het feit dat Europa adoptie voor paren van gelijk geslacht verdragsrechtelijk mogelijk heeft gemaakt.
Supports the convention's child-welfare safeguards but asks about the future adoption rules, the 50-year retention period, and whether victims of forced marriage are excluded.

They endorse its importance because the existing convention is badly outdated and because it now guarantees that adoptions outside the Hague Adoption Convention also take place in the child's best interest.

Zij onderschrijven het belang ervan daar het bestaande verdrag sterk verouderd is en omdat nu gewaarborgd wordt dat ook adopties die niet onder het Haags Adoptieverdrag vallen, eveneens op zodanige wijze plaatsvinden dat deze in het belang van het kind zijn.

Criticises weaker child protections in the convention (anonymous birth, six-week reflection period, no required court ruling in all cases) and asks whether the government will resist them and why the motion for 100-year retention is not followed.
Moreover, a judicial ruling is not always required; an administrative authority is sufficient.
Ook is er niet eens altijd een rechterlijke uitspraak vereist, maar volstaat ook een administratieve autoriteit.
Questions the added value of a separate European convention given subsidiarity and the Hague Convention, and asks why the 1967 convention was not ratified before.
To what extent do those arguments still apply now?
In hoeverre zijn die argumenten nu nog van toepassing?

32565-XV.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget (begrotingsstaten) of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the baten-lastendiensten budget, in line with the autumn budget memorandum (Najaarsnota). It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 December 2010, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Amendment of the budget statements of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2010 (amendment linked to the autumn budget memorandum)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2010 (wijziging samenhangende met de Najaarsnota)

33240-XVI.s: This is the supplementary budget act (Slotwet) for 2011 of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adjusting the departmental budget statement and the statement for its baten-lastendiensten. It sets the final 2011 appropriations and realised figures in thousands of euros, with the amendments taking effect from the day after publication and retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

33280-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation through a first supplementary budget tied to the spring memorandum, shifting spending and revenue across policy articles. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no changes to oversight or citizens' protections.

33480-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, shifting appropriations across articles in the second supplementary budget. It also authorises a multi-year budget reserve, charged to the central department's apparatus article, to cover state guarantees for residual debts of education institutions that default on loans, deviating from the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 for 2012.
33480-VIII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget reserve on administrative efficiency grounds, noting that five separate reserves would be unwieldy until a general statutory provision is adopted in the planned revision of the Comptabiliteitswet.
q: As part of the planned revision of the Comptabiliteitswet, a general statutory provision will be introduced.
In het kader van de voorgenomen herziening van de Comptabiliteitswet zal een algemene wettelijke voorziening worden getroffen.
p: Article 3 departs from article 5(4) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 by allowing a multi-year budget reserve to be held for 2012 for state guarantees to education institutions, with the general statutory rule to follow later.

33640-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and the budgets of its agencies, mainly by adjusting appropriations and revenues in line with the Spring Memorandum. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and provides that the act enters into force on 1 June 2013, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
33640-XIII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the Spring Memorandum, updated cost estimates and the transfer of funds between budget items, not by any new executive power.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for 2013, as set by the act of 18 April 2013
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII), alle voor het jaar 2013 en vastgesteld bij de wet van 18 april 2013

33750-VIII.s: This bill fixes the 2014 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the baten-lasten agencies, including a multi-year budget reserve for guarantees on residual debt of education institutions. The explanatory memorandum lists policy goals, indicators and budget allocations, with little delegation of rule-making power.
q: Notwithstanding Article 5(4) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, a multi-year budget reserve charged to the non-policy article Apparaatskosten (Article 95) is maintained for 2014.

In afwijking van artikel 5, vierde lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 wordt voor het jaar 2014 een meerjarige begrotingsreserve ten laste van het niet-beleidsartikel Apparaatskosten (artikel 95) aangehouden.

33782-(R2016).s: The bill approves the withdrawal of Dutch reservations for Aruba, Curaçao, Sint Maarten and the Caribbean Netherlands to the strike-right provisions of the ICESCR and the European Social Charter, which had limited strikes by public servants. The explanatory memorandum states that no further implementing legislation is needed because the right to strike is directly effective.
33782-(R2016).j: The memorandum justifies withdrawal by pointing to repeated recommendations from the UN and European committees and to case law recognising strikes by public servants as legitimate.
q: The right to strike is an acquired right for civil servants in the public sector, which the judiciary tests for its lawfulness and expediency.
Het stakingsrecht is voor ambtenaren in de publieke sector een verworven recht, dat door de rechterlijke macht op zijn rechtmatigheid en doelmatigheid wordt getoetst.
p: Withdrawal of reservations extends the right to strike to public servants, expanding citizens' labour rights against the state as employer.

parties: Asks what the current limitation on the right to strike entails, whether it conflicts with law, and why withdrawal is only now proposed.
The VVD members ask whether the government can indicate exactly what the current limitation on the right to strike entails.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering kan aangeven wat de huidige limitering van het stakingsrecht precies inhoudt.
Asks about the reasons for the original reservations, the practical changes foreseen, the risk of divergent regimes within the Kingdom, and whether Koninkrijkspartners were consulted.
The PvdA members note that the government wants to realise this through a rijkswet (kingdom act).
De leden van de PvdA-fractie constateren dat de regering een en ander wil realiseren door middel van een rijkswet.
Asks why the reservations are outdated, why steps are taken now, whether Sint Maarten will maintain its reservations, and with which parties consultation took place.
Is there a chance that Sint Maarten will maintain these reservations?
Is de kans aanwezig dat Sint Maarten deze voorbehouden zal handhaven?

33930-VIII.s: This bill is a slotwet that amends the 2013 budget statements of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and of the agencies DUO and the Nationaal Archief, and sets a multi-year budget reserve for 2013. It sets out the revised appropriations, expenditures and receipts by article, and the reporting of realisation figures for the agencies.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2013 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd

33955-(R2032).s: This bill (Rijkswet) approves a new bilateral tax arrangement between the Netherlands and Curaçao on income taxes, following the OECD model, covering residence, permanent establishment, dividends, interest, royalties, capital gains, employment income and avoidance of double taxation. It also includes provisions on transfer pricing, mutual agreement procedures, exchange of information and assistance in collection.
33955-(R2032).j: The memorandum justifies the arrangement as aligning with OECD standards and the Dutch treaty policy, and notes the regime has no unilateral executive discretion beyond the agreed text.
q: In addition, the treaty policy assessment scheme 2011 is attached to this explanatory memorandum, indicating for several parts whether the arrangement aligns with the NFV 2011.
Daarnaast is het toetsschema verdragsbeleid 2011 als bijlage bij deze memorie van toelichting gevoegd, waarin op een aantal onderdelen is aangegeven of de regeling aansluit bij de NFV 2011.
d: method of calculating tax credits under national law

parties: Asks about the arbitration procedure, timing of tie-breaker decisions for dual-residence entities, and the risk of Curaçao companies relocating after the abolition of existing practice.
Can the government respond to the criticism and questions of the Dutch Order of Tax Advisers about this tax arrangement?
Kan de regering ingaan op de kritiek en vragen van de Nederlandse Orde van Belastingadviseurs over deze Belastingregeling?
Stresses that control of abuse and improper use of the arrangement must be a high priority and questions whether the corporate tiebreaker sufficiently prevents tax avoidance.
They wonder whether the corporate tiebreaker is sufficient to prevent tax avoidance.
Zij vragen zich af of de «corporate tiebreaker» voldoende zoden aan de dijk zet om belastingontwijking te voorkomen.
Asks for explanations of the five-year transitional measure, the LOB clause, and the possible double non-taxation under the country-of-residence levy on dividends.
Does including an exclusive country-of-residence levy on participation dividends imply double non-taxation where the country of residence has no dividend tax, these members ask?
Houdt het opnemen van een uitsluitende woonstaatheffing op deelnemingsdividenden dubbele niet-heffing in, wanneer de woonstaat geen dividendbelasting kent, vragen deze leden?
Questions the tie-breaker procedure for dual-resident entities, the absence of arbitration where consultation fails, and whether the anti-abuse rule could be applied retroactively to existing cases.
Can the government commit that the said Article 17(3)(b) will not be applied to existing cases, ask the CDA members.
Kan de regering toezeggen dat genoemd artikel 17, derde lid, letter b in bestaande gevallen niet zal worden toegepast, zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie.
Asks why the 2012 agreed minutes were not implemented sooner, the status of customs arrangements with Caribbean Netherlands, and the duration and expected economic activity under the BRNC.
Why does it only come up now?
Waarom komt het nu pas aan de orde?
Asks for standard policy and fixed deadlines for residence determinations and pension rules, and questions discretionary bilateral decisions and unequal treatment among Kingdom islands.
Given the current number of dual-resident companies, the PAIS faction considers it very important that a standard policy be developed so that this provision is applied adequately.

Vanwege de huidige omvang van het aantal vennootschappen met dubbele vestigingsplaats acht de PAIS-fractie het van groot belang dat er een standaardbeleid wordt ontwikkeld om de toepassing van deze bepaling adequaat te laten verlopen.
Wants the full advice of the Raad van Advies included in the report, which objects to missing WJZ advice and unsupported budgetary neutrality claims.
The PS faction wishes to include the full advice of the Advisory Council of Curaçao in the report.
De PS-fractie wenst het advies van de Raad van Advies van Curaçao intergraal in het verslag op te nemen.

34038-(R2039).s: The bill approves for the entire Kingdom the Council of Europe Convention on preventing and combating violence against women and domestic violence, concluded in Istanbul on 11 May 2011, as required under Article 91 of the Constitution. It contains only approval and entry-into-force provisions and no delegation of powers.

parties: Asks whether the convention's ambitions are realistic, whether it creates enforceable individual rights, and how it fits with municipal policy freedom after decentralisation.
If so, which provisions of the convention does the government consider directly binding on everyone?
Zo ja, welke bepalingen uit het verdrag zijn naar de mening van de regering een ieder verbindend?
Asks whether a designated coordinating and monitoring body is needed, since Atria and the Human Rights College say the Ministry of VWS role is insufficient.
Atria and the Human Rights College state that such a body is lacking in the Netherlands and that the Ministry of VWS coordinating role on violence in dependency relationships is not sufficient.

Atria en het College voor de Rechten van de Mens geven aan dat een dergelijk orgaan in Nederland ontbreekt en dat de coördinerende rol van het Ministerie van VWS als het gaat om geweld in afhankelijkheidsrelaties (GIA) niet voldoet.
Worries that municipalities facing budget shortfalls after decentralisation may not implement the convention, and asks how the government will intervene and monitor.
How is it guaranteed that the bottlenecks now identified in chain cooperation will be resolved promptly despite the cuts?
Hoe wordt gegarandeerd dat de knelpunten die nu gesignaleerd worden in de ketensamenwerking ondanks de bezuinigingen voortvarend worden verholpen?
Supports the convention and asks about the gender scan results, the Caribbean islands timeline and the scope of municipal duties.
These members consider it important that violence against women and domestic violence is on the agenda of the Council of Europe.
Genoemde leden vinden het belangrijk dat geweld tegen vrouwen en huiselijk geweld een punt is op de agenda van de Raad van Europa.
Asks for an independent national oversight body and for public release of the gender scan, and questions whether the Article 12 ban on cultural justifications could reach accepted practices.
these members emphasise the importance of a national and independent oversight body and ask which steps the government is willing to take in this regard.
benadrukken deze leden het belang van een landelijk en onafhankelijk orgaan voor toezicht en vragen de regering welke stappen zij bereid is in dezen te nemen.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division supports the Istanbul Convention on violence against women and domestic violence but raises objections: non-extension to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba without a concrete timeframe, lack of a date for Aruba, and insufficient reporting on the gender-scan research. The government's reply accepts the Bonaire/Sint Eustatius/Saba and gender-sensitivity points and updates the explanatory memorandum, but does not set a date for Aruba.
concerns: Non-extension of the convention to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba needs a concrete reasonable deadline given its fundamental-rights character and high levels of domestic violence there.
The Afdeling asked for a timetable for Aruba's implementing legislation, which the government declined because the scope of that legislation is not yet clear.
The explanatory memorandum should report the results of the gender-scan research and its consequences for Dutch gender-sensitive policy.

34280-(R2058).s: The bill approves for Curaçao the 2014 Dutch-US agreement on improving international tax compliance and implementing FATCA. It has two articles: approval of the treaty and entry into force the day after Staatsblad publication.
q: The Treaty concluded at Willemstad on 16 December 2014 between the Kingdom of the Netherlands, on behalf of Curaçao, and the United States of America on improving international tax compliance and implementing FATCA is approved for Curaçao.

ARTIKEL I Het op 16 december 2014 te Willemstad tot stand gekomen Verdrag tussen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden, ten behoeve van Curaçao, en de Verenigde Staten van Amerika tot verbetering van de internationale naleving van de belastingplicht en de tenuitvoerlegging van de FATCA, waarvan de Engelse tekst is geplaatst in Tractatenblad 2015, 11 , en de vertaling in het Nederlands in Tractatenblad 2015, 144 wordt goedgekeurd voor Curaçao.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering advised proceeding with approval of the Curaçao FATCA intergovernmental agreement while urgently securing a exchange of letters with the US, as the 30 September 2015 target date appeared hard to meet and no equivalent to the Dutch arrangements existed for Curaçao. The Minister's reply reports that such an exchange of letters has been agreed with the US authorities before 30 September 2015 and that minor editorial corrections were made to the explanatory note.
concerns: Without an exchange of letters with the US, Curaçao-based financial institutions could face a 30% withholding tax from 30 September 2015, so the Afdeling advised securing such an exchange now.
The explanatory note wrongly described the Dutch exchange-of-letters arrangements as if they already applied between Curaçao and the US, and the Afdeling asked for this to be corrected.

34371-(R2066).s: This Rijkswet approves for Curaçao the Supplementary Agreement of 29 September 2015 to the FATCA agreement with the United States, which extends the deadline in the original treaty so it does not lapse on 30 September 2015. The bill enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad and sets no delegations.
34371-(R2066).j: The memorandum justifies the supplementary agreement as needed to adjust the deadline because parliamentary procedure could not finish in time, following the Council of State's advice to agree an additional arrangement with the US.
q: The Supplementary Agreement concerns adjusting the deadline.
Het Aanvullend Verdrag ziet op het aanpassen van de termijn.

parties: Asks what steps the State Secretary has taken on the promised channel to raise FATCA problems with the US, and whether the same problems will arise for Curaçao.
At the general consultation on the Tax Authority of 15 October 2015, the State Secretary promised to find a suitable channel to raise this problem with America.
Tijdens het algemeen overleg Belastingdienst van 15 oktober 2015 heeft de Staatssecretaris toegezegd een «passend kanaal» te zoeken om dit probleem aan te kaarten in Amerika.
Asks for justification of low tax-evasion risk in the pension sector, the administrative burden, Curaçao's staffing, and the basis for exempting certain investment entities from reporting.
Can it be explained which 'certain investment entities' are exempt from reporting obligations, asks the SP group?
Kan worden uitgelegd welke «bepaalde beleggingsentiteiten» zijn vrijgesteld van rapportageverplichtingen, vragen de leden van de SP-fractie?
Questions the delay in submitting the bill, the number of affected Curaçao residents, how they were informed, and the double taxation problems they face.
In the Netherlands it emerged that US persons run into enormous bureaucracy and in some cases even considerable double taxation.
In Nederland bleek dat US persons tegen een enorme bureaucratie aanlopen en in sommige gevallen zelfs tegen aanzienlijke dubbele belastingheffing.

34519-(R2071).s: The bill amends the Paspoortwet so that a passport holder can report a lost or possibly fraudulently used travel document through a prescribed procedure, which makes the document lapse by law without a police report, and it also lowers the age for court-granted substitute consent for a passport application from sixteen to twelve, adds lapse of a document when its citizen service number changes, and makes related technical amendments including to the Kieswet and penal provisions.
34519-(R2071).j: The memorandum justifies the lower age threshold by the best interest of the child in cases where minors reach a Dutch consular post, and says the court weighs interests before issuing a document.
q: This adjustment of the application procedure is in the interest of the child.
Deze aanpassing van de aanvraagprocedure is in het belang van het kind.
d: manner of reporting lost or fraud-suspected travel document
manner of reporting lost document in application procedure
p: Allows the Minister of Foreign Affairs or Governor to let a minor keep a passport despite withdrawn consent, lowering the age threshold to twelve, with the court deciding on substitute consent.

parties: Asks that abolishing the police report does not weaken the fight against identity fraud, and asks why reporting loss is not mandatory and what consequences non-reporting has.
The VVD members ask the government to state that this amendment will not come at the expense of combating identity fraud.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering aan te geven dat deze wetswijziging niet ten koste gaat van de bestrijding van identiteitsfraude.
Questions whether the three-minute assessment by municipal officials can reliably detect fraud and asks how careful verification and data sharing will be ensured.
Does the government agree with the PvdA members that a sound, correct assessment takes precedence over reducing the burden?
Is de regering het met de leden van de PvdA eens dat een degelijke, correcte beoordeling boven lastenvermindering gaat?
Asks whether the mandatory police report was a real obstacle to fraud enforcement and information exchange, and whether the Caribbean improvements apply only there.
Was the mandatory police report of a lost travel document an obstacle to adequate fraud enforcement and good information exchange, the CDA members ask.

Is de verplichte aangifte bij de politie van vermissing van een reisdocument een belemmering geweest voor adequate fraudebestrijding en goede informatie-uitwisseling, zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie.

Questions the lack of a mandatory immediate loss report, the dismissal of the Council of State advice without motivation, and the risk to victims' compensation and to the state's duty to protect privacy.
The D66 members are further curious why the government sets aside, without motivation, the advice of the Council of State's advisory division that an immediate loss report should not be optional.

De aan het woord zijnde leden zijn voorts benieuwd waarom de regering het advies van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State, om een directe melding van vermissing niet facultatief te laten zijn, zonder motivering aan de kant schuift.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised proceeding with the draft Paspoortwet amendment (abolishing mandatory police reporting of lost passports, direct reporting, lowering the age for judicial substitute consent to 12, and automatic expiry of documents with incorrect BSN) but recommended deleting the changes to article 36 on supervised minors and adding explanation on public information. The minister's reply accepted the advice on information and redrafting but kept the article 36 change, arguing it deliberately creates a dual regime for supervised minors aged 12-16.
concerns: The Afdeling advised that article 5a be redrafted to show that direct reporting of loss is not optional, and the minister redrafted accordingly in part.

The Afdeling said the changes to article 36 lowering the age limit create overlap and confusion and should be deleted; the minister kept the change but reworded the provision and memorie van toelichting.
The Afdeling asked for explanation of how the public will be informed of the changes, and a passage was added to the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asked that the Kieswet amendment be removed from the bill as it is not national law, but the minister kept it with motivation.

34725-XV.s: This supplementary budget act (slotwet) amends the 2016 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the budget of its agency, setting realized spending and revenue figures in thousands of euros. It works mainly by adjusting appropriation amounts across policy articles and retroactively effective from the end of the budget year.
34725-XV.j: The memorandum justifies the amounts by lower-than-expected uptake of schemes and unfinished projects in 2016, not by any new or expanded powers.
q: Uptake of this scheme was lower than expected in the autumn memorandum.
Het beroep op deze regeling is lager dan bij Najaarsnota verwacht.

34742-(R2091).s: The bill seeks parliamentary approval (rijkswet) for the 2013 amendments to the 1996 Protocol to the London Convention on marine dumping, which add a regulatory regime for marine geo-engineering such as ocean fertilisation. Entry into force is set for the first day after publication in the Staatsblad, and the Kingdom as a whole is bound.
34742-(R2091).j: The memorandum justifies the amendments by the precautionary approach and the need for a transparent, effective global mechanism to control marine geo-engineering, with permits subject to assessment, monitoring and possible revocation.
q: The decision to grant a permit may only be taken after the following steps have been completed and the necessary supervisory measures have been established.
Het besluit een vergunning af te geven mag alleen worden genomen nadat de volgende stappen zijn doorlopen en de nodige toezichtmaatregelen zijn vastgesteld.

parties: The VVD has read the bill and has no questions.
They have no questions about this.
Zij hebben hier geen vragen over.

The PVV asks whether harmful geo-engineering activities, existing or future, will be stopped and banned immediately once an assessment shows possible harm, and questions the exemption for offshore wind farms from stricter species protection rules.

Can these members rely on the fact that, if the assessment shows possible harmful effects of existing and future geo-engineering activities on the marine environment, these activities will be immediately stopped and banned?

Kunnen deze leden erop vertrouwen dat, indien uit de beoordeling blijkt dat er mogelijk schadelijke gevolgen zijn van bestaande en toekomstige geo-engineeringsactiviteiten voor het mariene milieu, deze activiteiten per direct worden stopgezet en verboden?

The CDA asks the government to define marine geo-engineering, list foreseeable activities, and explain how the general assessment framework of Article 6.3 of the Waterwet applies and when such activities could be permitted.
These members ask the government what the general assessment framework of Article 6.3 of the Waterwet is with regard to marine geo-engineering activities.
Deze leden vragen de regering wat het algemene beoordelingskader van artikel 6.3 van de Waterwet ten aanzien van mariene geo-engineeringsactiviteiten is.
The D66 has read the bill and has no questions.
They have no questions about this.
Zij hebben hier geen vragen over.
GroenLinks has comments and reservations on the protocol, which it has submitted in its input for the related Waterwet bill; no check-related point is stated in this report.
They have some comments and reservations about this.
Zij hebben hier enkele opmerkingen en bedenkingen bij.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised sending the bill approving the 2013 amendments to the London Protocol on marine geo-engineering to parliament, with remarks on extension to Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, on parliamentary approval for new annexes, and on referendability. The government's reply accepted the remarks, adding detail to the explanatory memorandum and adjusting the referendum reasoning.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to address progress on extending the original Protocol and the amendment to Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, which the government did by supplementing section V.
Article 7(f) of the Rijkswet does not cover new annexes, so parliamentary approval remains required for them, and the explanatory memorandum should say so, which the government did in section III.

The bill may not be referendable because approval is sought for the whole Kingdom, but the government argues referendability cannot yet be excluded while Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten have not requested extension.

34950-XV.s: This bill is a supplementary budget law (Slotwet) for 2017 that adjusts the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the budget of its agency, based on realised expenditure and commitments. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2017 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2017 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35350-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2019 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (second supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy articles such as industry sustainability, energy supply and Groningen. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and gives the amended statement effect from the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2019.
q: We Willem-Alexander, by the grace of God, King of the Netherlands, Prince of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc. To all who shall see or hear read these presents, greetings!
Wij Willem-Alexander, bij de gratie Gods, Koning der Nederlanden, Prins van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz. Allen, die deze zullen zien of horen lezen, saluut!

35391-(R2144).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the 2014 Montreal Protocol amending the Tokyo Convention on offences committed aboard aircraft, covering in-flight security officers, aircraft commander powers and jurisdiction. The explanatory memorandum notes that most provisions need no national implementation, while some Dutch Penal Code and aviation regulation provisions are adjusted.
35391-(R2144).j: The memorandum justifies the protocol's rules on commander powers and jurisdiction as implementing a international treaty that the Netherlands has accepted, with the commander keeping final responsibility.
q: A large majority of ICAO states (including the Netherlands) held that there should be no misunderstanding about the commander's role and that the commander must remain ultimately responsible aboard the aircraft.

Een ruime meerderheid van alle ICAO-verdragsstaten (met inbegrip van Nederland) was van mening dat over deze rol van de gezagvoerder geen misverstand mocht bestaan en dat de gezagvoerder de eindverantwoordelijkheid moet blijven houden aan boord van het vliegtuig.
p: The protocol expands aircraft commander powers to maintain order aboard, including over in-flight security officers, with the commander retaining final responsibility.

parties: Asks about the feasibility of guidelines on a common list of offences, and what resources and shared blacklists are needed to exclude disruptive passengers from flights.
The VVD members ask for a targeted approach to be able to tackle air rage firmly.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen een gerichte aanpak om vlieghufters hard te kunnen aanpakken.
Supports ratification given the importance of effective action against offences aboard aircraft, and asks how implementation, simplified reporting and passenger awareness will be promoted.
The D66 members support ratification of the treaty amendments, given the importance of effective action against criminal acts committed aboard an aircraft.

De leden van de D66-fractie ondersteunen de ratificatie van de wijzigingen in het verdrag, gezien het belang van effectief optreden tegen het begaan van strafbare handelingen aan boord van een vliegtuig.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft rijkswet approving the 2014 Montreal Protocol amending the Tokyo Convention on offences on board aircraft, raising no substantive objections and only a drafting correction to the Dutch translation of article V. The government's nader rapport accepts the editorial remark, corrects the translation in Trb. 2020, 3, and updates the explanatory memorandum to reflect entry into force on 1 January 2020.
concerns: The Afdeling noted a translation error in article V, referring to 'derde lid' instead of 'artikel 3', which the government corrected.

35850-XV.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (first supplementary budget), adjusting spending and commitments across policy articles such as labour market, social assistance, unemployment and childcare. It mainly reallocates appropriations and sets the effective date of the amendment, delegating no rule-making power.
35850-XV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to updated forecasts and execution data, not by any new powers for the executive.
q: The total change in the first supplementary budget amounts to minus € 6.0 thousand in expenditure and in commitments.
Het totaal van de mutatie 1e suppletoire begroting bedraagt -/- € 6,0 duizend bij de uitgaven en bij de verplichtingen.

36100-XIX.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Nationaal Groeifonds, the national growth fund, through a closing budget adjustment (Slotwet) that records the realised figures against the authorised budget. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, and the explanatory memorandum extract is absent.
q: is amended, as appears from the corresponding budget statement attached to this law.
wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36120-XIV.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statutes of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the agencies budget and the Animal Health Fund through a first supplementary budget, with figures in thousands of euros and retroactive effect to 1 June 2022. It sets out budget mutations across policy articles, the NVWA agency and the Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland, without delegating rule-making or new powers to the executive.
q: We have found and resolved, with joint consultation of the States General ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) for 2022 is amended.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV) voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd.

36120-XVI.s: This first supplementary budget for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for 2022 amends the departmental budget statement, the agency budget statement and the budget fund statement, with figures in thousands of euros and effect from the day after publication (retroactive to 1 June 2022). The explanatory memorandum reports shortfalls and additional allocations in health insurance, long-term care, RIVM and related items, with no new delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
36120-XVI.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to higher-than-expected use of subsidy and compensation schemes and to additional funding needs, not by any new executive power.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2022

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2022

36233-(R2175).s: The bill approves the 2021 extradition treaty between the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the United Arab Emirates for the whole Kingdom, as required under Article 91(1) of the Constitution. The explanatory memorandum justifies the treaty by the need to fight serious and undermining crime and sets out safeguards on data transfer and the specialty principle.
36233-(R2175).j: The memorandum justifies the treaty as necessary to combat serious and undermining crime with an international dimension, and notes that bilateral extradition arrangements work better than multilateral ones.

parties: Asks whether the treaty's transfer rules are consistent with existing sentenced-person transfer treaties, whether sentences will be fully served, and whether victims' interests are weighed.
Can the government also confirm that a Dutch drug smuggler sentenced to fifteen years in the UAE must actually serve the full remaining sentence in the Netherlands?

Kan de regering daarnaast bevestigen dat een veroordeelde Nederlandse drugssmokkelaar die in de VAE vijftien jaar cel heeft opgelegd gekregen, ook daadwerkelijk in Nederland zijn volledige strafrestant moet uitzitten?

Questions how the treaty relates to violations of other human rights in the UAE such as the right to a fair trial, and how terrorism exceptions fit with UN findings on torture and lack of procedural rights.
These members ask how this treaty relates to violations of other human rights in the UAE, such as the right to a fair trial.
Deze leden vragen hoe dit verdrag zich verhoudt tot de schending van andere mensenrechten in de VAE, zoals het recht op een eerlijk proces.
Agrees with the government that cooperation with other countries is important to tackle undermining crime and prevent impunity.
They agree with the government that it is of great importance for the Kingdom to cooperate with other countries to tackle undermining crime as effectively as possible and prevent impunity.

Deze leden zijn het met de regering eens dat het van groot belang is dat het Koninkrijk met andere landen samenwerkt om ondermijnende criminaliteit zo effectief mogelijk aan te pakken en straffeloosheid te voorkomen.
Supports the treaty's death penalty and political offence exceptions but asks about independence of the UAE judiciary, adequate defence rights, and data protection safeguards.
In addition, the functioning of independent judiciary in the UAE is not addressed.
Daarnaast komt het functioneren van onafhankelijke rechtspraak in de VAE niet aan bod.
Questions whether the UAE respects ECHR and ICCPR fundamental rights, how compliance is monitored, and whether independent human rights verification should be a condition for the treaty.
These members ask how this implementation is checked or safeguarded in advance, given that, as the Council of State's advice also shows, the UAE does not allow human rights checks.
Deze leden vragen hoe deze uitvoering van tevoren gecontroleerd, dan wel geborgd wordt nu, ook uit het advies van de Afdeling, blijkt dat de VAE geen mensenrechtencontroles toestaat.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised in July 2022 on the draft law approving the extradition treaty with the United Arab Emirates, asking the government to address human rights conditions in the UAE in the explanatory memorandum. The government's reply of October 2022 disputes that the advice is correct in part, but accepts adding a human rights paragraph (new section 1.4) and other additions to the memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum assess the human rights situation in the UAE (torture, political prisoners, fair trial, monitoring), which the government addresses by adding a new section 1.4 while disputing that the Afdeling's broad reading of the trust principle is correct.

The Afdeling reads the trust principle as subject to a general exception for flagrant denial of justice in the UAE, which the government rejects as implying that all extradition cooperation with the UAE would be impossible.

36250-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (second supplementary budget) and the budget for its executive agencies, shifting appropriations among subsidies, energy support and Groningen measures. It makes no delegation of rule-making power and does not alter oversight or judicial review.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) and of the budget statement for the agencies of this ministry, all for the year 2022.

Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (XIII) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen van dit ministerie, alle voor het jaar 2022.

36360-VIII.s: This budget-amendment bill (Slotwet) changes the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budgets of the agencies DUO and the Nationaal Archief, with amounts in thousands of euros. It sets out the 2022 budget changes by policy article and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2022 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36435-XV.s: The bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, the agency budget statement and the budget fund statement, mainly reflecting supplementary budget changes for benefit schemes such as WAO, IVA, WGA and sickness-related regulations. It also sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively from 19 September 2023.
q: Based on implementation information from the UWV, the estimates have been adjusted by a net -€29.5 million.
Op basis van de uitvoeringsinformatie van het UWV zijn de ramingen bijgesteld met per saldo – € 29,5 miljoen.

36820-XX.s: The bill amends the 2025 budget of the Ministry of Asylum and Migration, adjusting spending and commitments across policy articles and the Immigration and Naturalisation Service (IND) budget, following a September supplementary budget. It sets the adjusted budget statements, states that figures are in thousands of euros, and makes the law effective retroactively from 16 September 2025.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Asylum and Migration for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Asiel en Migratie voor het jaar 2025

36910-(R2218).s: This Kingdom law (rijkswet) provides statutory bases, via general government measures (AMvRB), for several previously unanchored orders concerning the transfer of Netherlands Antilles rights and debts, voluntary aid organisations and a medal, Curaçao and Sint Maarten task arrangements, and ship security and navigation. It also amends the Public Prosecution law to allow a budget and accountability system to be set by AMvRB and transitionally keeps existing AMvRBs in force.
36910-(R2218).j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the bill by the need to give statutory grounds to existing AMvRBs that lost their basis after the 2023 Statute amendment, with a temporary validity of at most two years.
q: Such an AMvRB has a period of validity of at most two years.
Een dergelijke AMvRB heeft een werkingsduur van ten hoogste twee jaar.
d: transfer of Netherlands Antilles rights, debts and social insurance bank position
voluntary aid, volunteer medal, Curaçao/Sint Maarten task arrangements, ship security and navigation
budget and accountability system for public prosecution offices
p: Existing ministerial and general government orders without a statutory basis are given legal force by this Kingdom law, which is limited to a validity of at most two years and lapses automatically after that period.

parties: Asks how Curaçao, Aruba and Sint Maarten were involved in the bill and what their reaction was.
To what extent were Curaçao, Aruba and Sint Maarten involved in this bill?
In hoeverre zijn Curaçao, Aruba en Sint Maarten betrokken geweest bij onderhavig wetsvoorstel?
Raises the democratic deficit within the Kingdom and asks whether the other three countries support the bill and the consensus AMvRB.
The essence of the democratic deficit is that the countries are insufficiently involved or have insufficient influence over national legislation.
De essentie van het democratisch tekort is dat de landen onvoldoende betrokken zijn dan wel onvoldoende invloed hebben op rijkswetgeving.
Welcomes the creation of the necessary bases for general measures of national government and has no further questions.
These members think it is good that the necessary bases for general measures of national government are created and have no further questions.
Deze leden vinden het goed dat de benodigde grondslagen voor Algemene maatregelen van Rijksbestuur gecreëerd worden en hebben geen verdere vragen.
Has no questions about the bill.
These members have no questions about the bill before us.
Deze leden hebben geen vragen over voorliggend wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, without substantive remarks, that the draft Kingdom Act providing statutory grounds for general administrative measures of the Kingdom government (Rijkswet delegatiegrondslagen art. 38(2) Statute) be submitted. The government's reply confirms the draft was clarified in the explanatory memorandum to ensure existing general measures without statutory basis keep their force.
